title: Self-Inspecting Infrastructure Network — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Coordinates inspection systems that detect defects and prioritize repairs. A proposed network that inspects infrastructure continuously: drones, crawlers, and fixed sensors feed a coordination layer that detects defects, assesses severity, prioritizes repairs by risk, and dispatches inspection resources where they matter most.
capabilities: Coordinate drones, crawlers, and fixed sensors
Detect defects from inspection data
Prioritize repairs by risk, not just severity
Allocate inspection resources to highest-value targets
Track defect history per asset over time
